content: The Official 24/7 league is approximately 21 hours into its current session with two strategy families—Cosmo & Wanda and Timmy—competing across Top 20 and Top 50 pair universes. Cosmo & Wanda Top 20, the incumbent champion, holds a pristine 64–0 realized record with three champion exits, yet net equity sits near breakeven (~$999.37) because a concentrated –$52.94 unrealized open book (worst open –42.6%) threatens to erase its realized gains. The Top 50 challenger variant is underwater at ~$997.86 despite 11 realized wins, following a recent restart. Timmy variants lead league equity on paper—Top 20 at ~$1,010.04 and Top 50 at ~$1,005.95—but both rely entirely on unrealized carry; Timmy Top 50 has recorded the family’s only realized exit, a loss. All four teams are online with verified heartbeats, though low closed-trade counts keep sample quality flagged as unreliable, making the next several exits high-information events for trust calibration.
